capabilities: show newly created and recently modified files in a list
sort the list by file name in ascending or descending order
clear the entire list of tracked files
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition or flashcard review tool; it only lists recently created and modified files.
extras: The README includes a screenshot and a Usage section that are otherwise empty; clearing the list is irreversible.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that gathers newly created and recently updated files into one reviewable list.
summary: Review list that shows newly created and recently modified files so you can revisit recent changes.
